requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:32 requires /app/solution.py to exist; test.sh:125-129 re-invokes it with the exact command shape when checking idempotency. Tool must live at /app/solution.py and accept --config, --assets, --out.
test.sh:28 requires /app/result.json to exist; test.sh:59-73 asserts exact content of the four top-level fields: kept, deleted, missing, invalid.
must_include: exactly these four fields: kept, deleted, missing, invalid

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:76-80 asserts kept and deleted are sorted ascending by path; missing sorted ascending by (id, path); invalid sorted ascending by (id, reason).

test.sh:93-95 requires intro/a.playable.meta to remain on disk and not appear in deleted; test.sh:210 requires note.meta to survive the independent fixture. This encodes the rule that only .playable/.prefab are managed and .meta is never touched.
test.sh:89-91 requires hand/keep.playable to stay on disk and not appear in deleted; test.sh:209 requires hand.playable to survive the independent fixture. This encodes the .handauthored exemption.

test.sh:59 asserts kept list content; test.sh:84-86 asserts a disabled entry's file (boss/b.playable) is deleted from disk and appears in deleted; test.sh:211 asserts the disabled entry's orphan in the independent fixture is deleted. Encodes: desired = valid-enabled entries' required lists; disabled/invalid own nothing.
must_include: exist on disk AND are in the desired set

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:66-73 asserts exact invalid records with reasons drawn from exactly {mutex_flags, bad_key, duplicate_id}; each reason has a specific triggering condition.
must_include: use_timeline AND use_cutscene are BOTH true
does not start with the prefix 'cutscene_'
two or more entries share the same id

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:66-73 shows dup appears once as a dedup'd duplicate_id record but test.sh:107 asserts dup/x.playable is deleted from disk. Both dup entries are invalid; the rule is: duplicate_id flags EVERY entry carrying that id, not only the extra copies.
must_include: for EVERY entry carrying that id

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:66-73 shows e8 emits both bad_key and mutex_flags as two separate invalid records; the two dup entries collapse into a single {dup, duplicate_id} record after dedup. Rule: one record per triggered reason, final list is UNIQUE {id, reason} pairs.

test.sh:107-111 asserts dup/x.playable, m/m.playable, bad/n.playable are all deleted from disk — because their entries are invalid and own nothing, so their required-paths become orphans and fall to the deleted list.

test.sh:64 asserts missing == [{id: e3, path: win/c.prefab}]; test.sh:101 asserts win/c.prefab is absent from disk; test.sh:214 asserts missing == [{t3, c.playable}] in the independent fixture. Rule: for each valid-enabled entry, required paths absent from disk emit missing records.
must_include: does not currently exist on disk becomes a missing record

requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh:61 asserts exact deleted list; test.sh:103 asserts stray/z.prefab (unowned orphan) is deleted; test.sh:212 asserts extra.prefab in the independent fixture is deleted. Rule: every managed file not in any valid-enabled desired set is deleted, unless in .handauthored.
must_include: Every managed file (.playable or .prefab) under the assets root
NOT in the desired set of any valid enabled entry

must_include: No absolute paths anywhere in the report
